name: Accuracy, avoidability, hit chance, guards and incoming damage
status: Published formula (no status label on the MeowDB card)
inputs_note: Accuracy, avoid, magic and defense all come from total stats: base AP plus equipment and buffs.
floor_rule: Each floor is applied exactly where shown. Equipment and skill bonuses are added to the matching derived stat afterward.

magician.formula: Magician ACC = floor((1.2 × INT + 2 × Level + 0.6 × LUK) / 5.1 + 20)

derived_accuracy.rounding: floor of the whole expression (floor(Common / divisor + constant))

avoidability.rounding: each term floored separately, then summed

outgoing_hit.status: Published formula (no status label on the MeowDB card)
outgoing_hit.applies_to: Whether your attack connects. Physical attacks and spells use the same hit test.

automatic_hit.description: The game compares your accuracy to the monster's avoid with a random spread. A big enough accuracy lead skips the roll.

notes: Every offensive Magician spell can miss. Physical attacks and offensive spells use this shared target hit check. Some status actions disable the automatic-hit shortcut and still perform the same roll.
Summons use your hit roll and the Darkness check. Against bosses they never get the automatic hit.

rules: The automatic-hit test is evaluated before the q-based probability.
L uses max(1, MobLevel) - PlayerLevel, floored at 0.

darkness.status: Published formula (no status label on the MeowDB card)
darkness.note: Darkness is a separate miss check rolled after the attack hits. It does not lower your accuracy.

incoming_hit.status: Published formula (no status label on the MeowDB card)
incoming_hit.rescue_note: After a candidate miss, apply the independent 8% minimum-hit rescue:
incoming_hit.magic_note: Physical uses WDEF after physical evasion and guard. Magic uses MDEF and bypasses the physical evasion and guard path.
incoming_hit.monster_magic_note: Monster magic attacks use their magic attack value and the MDEF curve without the physical miss roll.

rules: Player level and monster level are floored at 1.
The 8% rescue is applied after the candidate chance, including the far-miss clamp branch.

guards.status: Published formula (no status label on the MeowDB card)
guards.note: Guards only work against regular attacks. Monster skills always get through.
formulas: ClawGuardChance = 3% at Lv 1-6 · 4% at Lv 7-13 · 5% at Lv 14-20
guards.combine_rule: When both are available, use the larger chance. A successful guard fully negates an eligible regular physical hit.
guards.beginner_relevance: Only Shield Guard can apply to a Beginner (needs an equipped shield with WDEF); Claw Guard is a Hermit skill.

incoming_damage.status: Published formula (no status label on the MeowDB card)
incoming_damage.touch_zone_note: The touch zone deals contact damage when you walk into it. Attack power is a percent of the monster's own damage stat: physical attacks use P.DMG, magic attacks use M.DMG.
incoming_damage.midpoint_note: The calculator's middle damage value uses `U = 0.5`, or a `1.3` attack roll.

elemental_resistance.status: Published formula (no status label on the MeowDB card)
notes: Applies to monster attacks with an element, magic and physical.
Applied after defense, before the damage cap.
Touching a monster deals damage with no element, so resistance never reduces it.

statements: A monster attack that misses you or that you block gives the same 1.5 s.

defensive_skills_not_beginner.status: MeowDB's Model (MeowDB's own model of the mechanic; not a confirmed game constant)
formulas: Magic Guard survival = min(HyperBodyHP + MaxMP, HyperBodyHP / (1 - Transfer))
At 100% transfer: Magic Guard survival = HyperBodyHP + MaxMP

gaps: Monster knockback on being hit (when a monster is pushed back / staggers) has only the glossary definition; no formula. See movement.json.
Which monster "attack ratio" applies to non-touch monster attacks is per-skill monster data (monsters domain); only touch hits (100) are documented here.
